palindrome:
Able was I saw Elba. This is a famous palindrome, but it's only 9 characters long. To create a palindrome at least 105 characters long, we can simply repeat this phrase multiple times to make it longer.

Here’s an example:

"Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba."

This repetition results in a palindrome that is 105 characters long.
